headline: Watch: the Iran-Hormuz standoff continues with no new strikes confirmed, keeping fuel the main risk for SA; today's SA power-outage flags were false alarms.
summary: Iran's parliament speaker says Hormuz will never return to its pre-war status and the 'ball is in the US court' on talks, while President Trump says fresh strikes are very unlikely if talks progress; Hormuz traffic is still only a few ships a day. Brent eased about 1% to US$91.80 but the Australian dollar slipped again, so SA fuel prices stay high. Six 'possible large power outage' flags in SA today were not confirmed: the dips matched normal midday rooftop-solar lows, demand is back to normal (942 MW) and no widespread outages were reported. Locally, fire danger is Moderate in the Hills with no bans or warnings.
